description: This PHP class defines a data model 'ClaimAttachmentModel' within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin API. It represents claim attachment data, including metadata such as file info and the attached employee's details, with serialization and normalization capabilities.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentModel
classes.description: Data model representing an attachment associated with a claim, including metadata and attached employee info, for serialization in API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a PartialClaimAttachment entity and configures serialization filters and attribute mappings.
